scope_note: Deepen the two shallow Caspian clusters (azerbaijan-caspian, kazakhstan-caspian) with real source-backed boarding points, intra-national corridors, and hand-waypoint guidance. Caspian is a CLOSED sea; Baku<->Aktau is ~250+ nm (cross-border) >> N30 70nm range -> NOT a Navier corridor (stays ferry-context only). All Navier corridors here are intra-national coastal.
no_invention_rule: Every BP is a real named place with a source URL. Approximate positions describe the named place; Grok does deterministic gazetteer promotion + exact coords + ID-match seal.

azerbaijan-caspian.geography_note: Baku is on the SOUTH shore of the Absheron peninsula (Baku Bay opens south/southeast). Sea Breeze (Nardaran) and Bilgah are on the NORTH shore of Absheron. A sea route between them MUST round the eastern tip of the peninsula (Cape Shuvalan / Amburan area) offshore -- never cross the peninsula by land.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Baku Seaside Boulevard Pier
boarding_point_candidates.note: City-center excursion pier at the Seaside National Park; daily boat departures.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Sea Breeze Marina Village (Nardaran)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Large master-planned Caspian resort city on the north Absheron coast; Marina Village + Mirvari / Caspian Dreamliner yacht operations.

boarding_point_candidates.name: White Beach Club jetty (Sea Breeze)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Beach club within Sea Breeze resort; waterfront terrace + beach access.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Bilgah Beach Hotel jetty
boarding_point_candidates.note: Bilgah settlement ~44 km north of Baku city; beach hotel on the north Absheron coast.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Amburan Beach Club (Bilgah)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Premium beach club adjacent to Bilgah; north Absheron coast.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Port of Baku (Alat) ferry terminal
boarding_point_candidates.note: Main Baku international/ferry port relocated to Alat ~70 km south of Baku; Trans-Caspian gateway. Endpoint for a southern coastal commuter corridor; also ferry-context node.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Round the eastern tip of the Absheron peninsula OFFSHORE (east of Cape Shuvalan/Amburan). Do NOT route across the peninsula neck. Waypoint ~1-2 nm off the eastern headland.
Same Absheron-tip rounding as above; continue NW along the north coast to Bilgah.
Short coastal run along the north Absheron shore; keep offshore of Nardaran shallows.

corridors.desc: city to Trans-Caspian port / worker shuttle
corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Coastal run SOUTH along Baku Bay; clear the Bayil/Shikhov headland and Alat port breakwaters with an offshore waypoint. Range-edge (near 70nm round trip) -- verify N30 duty cycle.

kazakhstan-caspian.geography_note: Aktau (Mangystau) sits on a cliff coast; Kuryk port is ~40 nm south in a bay. Coastal routing hugs the Mangystau shore; round the intervening headlands offshore.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Aktau Seaport
boarding_point_candidates.note: Aktau commercial + passenger seaport; yacht 'Maestro' 1-hour Caspian cruises operate from here.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Aktau Embankment / Seaside Promenade (Skalnaya Tropa)
boarding_point_candidates.note: 1.5 km cliff-and-sea walking promenade with 24 viewing platforms; central waterfront landing.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Caspian Riviera Grand Palace private seafront
boarding_point_candidates.note: Aktau seafront hotel with private beach/terrace on the Caspian shore.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Kuryk Port ferry terminal
boarding_point_candidates.note: Kuryk deep-water ferry/RoRo port ~30 km from Kuryk village; Trans-Caspian gateway. Aktau<->Kuryk shuttle candidate.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Route SOUTH along the Mangystau cliff coast; place an offshore waypoint to clear the headland(s) between Aktau and the Kuryk bay entrance. No land crossing across the peninsula.
Short run along the Aktau cliff shore.
Short protected run inside the Aktau waterfront.

excluded_context_only.reason: Cross-border closed-sea ferry ~250+ nm >> N30 70nm range. Context/ferry only; NOT a Navier corridor. Keep in coverage prose, not in minted routes.
